chapter.p: Holy Ones are the righteous ones, also known as the saints of the Holy One of Israel. (See 2 Nephi 6:7 CE.) Holy ones or saints are supposed to be identified as baptized followers of Christ — holy, sacred, consecrated, and pure — and in the scriptures they often are, but historically they have also fallen short of that description. Sanctification is the process of becoming a holy one. See SAINT; SANCTIFICATION.
